notes:
Summary: Large multi-category retailer (home + apparel) evaluating Redwood for semantic catalog search + reranking. Primary drivers: improve relevance (CTR & conversion on search results), cap cost-per-query during seasonal spikes (Black Friday/holiday), and meet EU data residency and audit requirements.

Current tech & constraints:
- Product catalog ~18M unique SKUs after variants; canonicalization in progress.
- Current system: custom ML reranker + Elastic for candidate generation; high maintenance, poor scaling during spikes.
- Target SLO: p50 < 80ms end-to-end for search + rerank (user-facing), p95 < 400ms; willing to trade slight throughput for lower cost per query in non-peak windows.
- Cost sensitivity: CFO wants model showing <$0.005 per query at baseline traffic, and <$0.02 per query at 5x holiday peak.
- Data requirements: EU product/customer segments must remain in EU region; audit logs retained 12 months; SSO + SCIM required.

POC details / asks:
- Indexing scale: need guidance on sharding strategy for 18M vectors, hybrid storage recommendations (SSD+memory), and refresh strategies for hourly price/availability updates.
- Embedding model: want candidate embeddings for titles + attributes; open to Redwood-verified open models if cost/latency align.
- Rerank: need a 2-stage pipeline: fast candidate gen (approximate) then lightweight transformer rerank for top-10; measure p99 for rerank stage separately.
- Autoscaling: must handle 5x traffic spikes with predictable cost; ask for simulation of costs across 1x/3x/5x load.

Quotes & paraphrases from stakeholders:
- "If we can't see ~30% improvement in relevance > we won't switch" - Head of Search (K. Moreno).
- "Need clear cost math — finance won't sign without holiday stress test" - VP Finance.

Open items / next actions:
- Redwood to deliver cost-per-query model and two cost scenarios by 2026-03-17.
- SE to provide sharding + storage whiteboard and expected indexing time for 18M vectors (by 2026-03-14).
- Schedule on-prem benchmarking session for security team (requested window 2026-03-22 to 2026-03-26).

Staging notes (CRM style):
- Lead source: partner integration (SearchWorks Integrator).
- Likely timeline: Q2 procurement if POC meets latency + cost targets.
- Risk: incumbent contract with custom infra tiling into 2026-09; procurement team needs clear TCO delta.

Contact cadence: weekly syncs (Priya + Marcus), security calls ad-hoc.
